Subject: Request: technical demo for dev trial

Hi Soojin,

I signed up for the developer trial through the docs quickstart earlier this morning and started poking around the embeddings + retrieval examples. Our engineering team (Priya and I) want to schedule a short technical walkthrough to validate latency and integration patterns with our vector store. Ideally we'd cover:

- model selection/latency expectations for multi-region reads
- recommendations around prefix caching & batching for short queries
- how Dedicated routing would look if we scale to several hundred QPS

I've attached a short architecture sketch to give context (nebulalabs-arch-draft.pdf). We're based in PST — weekday afternoons work best.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Platform Engineer
Nebula Labs

Hi Priya / Alex — happy to take this. Short answers:
- KV cache: yes, we'll demo behavior with short repetitive prompts and show how prefix/KV caching and batching reduce token cost without increasing tail latency.
- Sample data: synthetic vectors are fine for the first pass; bring a small (<=10k vectors) export if you want us to run a closer production-like test.

Suggested additions to the agenda:
- 5 min: topology and where in your stack Redwood will sit (ping me if you want a pre-call diagram)
- 10 min: live perf run (median vs 95th percentile latency + token cost)
- 5 min: quantization/placement recommendations for Dedicated vs hosted routing

I'll create a calendar invite with a Zoom link and include a short checklist for the sample payload.
